title: Chess: game wrapper, starting position, basic piece movement
description: ChessGame wrapper class with 8x8 board, standard 32-piece setup, move generation for king (step), queen (slide ortho+diag), rook (slide ortho), bishop (slide diag), knight (leap 1,2). Basic move execution (pick up, place, capture). No special moves yet. Foundation for all other chess issues.
close_reason: ChessGame wrapper with standard setup, basic piece movement (king/queen/rook/bishop/knight), move execution. 26 tests.
